messages.subject: NA
parts:
I am new to this list, and new to program Distance. I have questions
specifically about structuring point count data for importing into the program.
My point counts stations were not set up along transects, and were visited in a
different order each time (five visits to each station over the season). It
seems to me that program Distance is set up for points taken along transects.
Will the difference in sample size in any way affect the program's density
estimates? And how do I input the area of the points into the program?

Thanks in advance to anyone who can help,

Claire Crow
cr...@email.arizona.edu
